Set up and evaluate the APV of a loan (internal use)

apv_helpers.Rd

.apv_setup() checks the inputs of calculate_apv() and solve_irr() and computes everything that does not depend on the discount rate (event probabilities and cash flows). .apv_moments() computes the APV, its second moment, and its standard deviation for a given monthly discount rate.

Usage

.apv_setup(
  x,
  cur_age,
  orig_term,
  orig_loan_amt,
  mon_pmt,
  recov_curve,
  orig_apy,
  type
)

.apv_moments(setup, rate)

Arguments

x

An object of class alife_multi. Typically the output of the estimate_hazard function with two event types.

cur_age

Current age of the loan in months.

orig_term

Original loan term in months.

orig_loan_amt

Original loan amount.

mon_pmt

Monthly payment amount.

recov_curve

Recovery curve data.frame with columns month and recovery (the recovery rate as a proportion of orig_loan_amt). It must contain every month from cur_age to orig_term - 1.

orig_apy

Internal loan APY for amortization. Defaults to 0.15.

type

A character string specifying the extrapolation type passed to extend_hazard(): either "constant" (default), "geometric" or "linear".

setup

The output of .apv_setup().

rate

A monthly discount rate.

Value

.apv_setup() returns a list with the number of remaining months, the default and prepayment probabilities, and the cash flows for each remaining month. .apv_moments() returns the same list as calculate_apv().
